capabilities: Locks Obsidian on startup, idle time, focus loss, system lock or on demand
Sets a password with a one-time recovery key
Customises lock screen theme, background photo or video, clock and animations
Plays three offline games on the lock screen with saved best scores
Logs the last 50 locks, unlocks and wrong passwords
disambiguation: Not encryption: it only covers the screen and does not protect the note files, which stay readable in the vault folder.
extras: Desktop only (macOS and Windows), requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. Free and open source, makes no network requests. Settings can be kept local to one computer; the plugin folder syncs with the vault if you sync it.
problem: An unlocked, unattended Obsidian window can be used or read by anyone at the keyboard, and Obsidian has no built-in screen lock.
summary: Password lock screen that covers Obsidian on startup, idle, focus loss or system lock, with themes, backgrounds and offline games.
